senses.en_definition: A promise to do or give something.
An extension of time or a postponement (archaic).
An appointed time or limit, especially the time of death (literary or euphemistic).

collocations.en: one's allotted span of life has run its course

messages.en: You promised you'd come tonight, right? Don't forget!
I haven't forgotten! I've already bought the present, too. Eight at your place, right?
Yep, that's right. If you're going to be late, text me beforehand, okay? That way I can work out when we can cut the cake.
My heart's racing. I'm about to go on stage.
I felt the same way earlier. You've had loads of practice, right?
Are we driving to that shop?
The shop's only a short walk from here. Let's walk.

senses.en_definition: A rough unit of length, width or thickness based on the length or breadth of a finger.
An object or part shaped like a finger, such as a spoke or slender bar.

messages.en: What are you up to? You've been typing for ages, but no message has come through 😂
My finger hurts. I got it caught in a door earlier. Even typing is a struggle.
That explains it. Just send a voice note. No need to type out a long message.
